# PinkOut

> PinkOut is a women-first lifestyle, entertainment and community destination coming soon to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Core idea: Your Own World.

## Official website
- [Arabic homepage](https://pinkout.asem.work/): Primary Arabic launch information.
- [English homepage](https://pinkout.asem.work/en/): Full English launch information.
- [Destinations](https://pinkout.asem.work/en/#world): Pink Passage, Rose Hub, Beauty Lab, Make Studio, Pink Market, Move Studio and PinkOut Live.
- [App](https://pinkout.asem.work/en/#app): The upcoming PinkOut app will handle schedules, reservations, tickets and ongoing community participation.
- [FAQ](https://pinkout.asem.work/en/#faq): Current public answers about PinkOut.
- [Partnerships](https://pinkout.asem.work/en/#partners): Brand collaborations and talent enquiries.

## Confirmed public positioning
- Created primarily for women; final admission and companion policies are pending.
- General entry is planned at SAR 35, including selected free activities. Premium experiences may cost extra through the app.
- PinkOut is designed to continue beyond the first physical event through its app and community.
- The website is a launch and discovery site, not a booking platform.

## Pending information
The exact opening date, street address, app-store URLs, social handles, business email, final age and companion policies, privacy policy and terms are not confirmed. Programming examples are proposals, not a confirmed launch schedule. Project visuals are concept renders. No named sponsor or partner is confirmed on this website. Future home beauty services are not presented as available.

## Form availability
This static version has no backend. Waitlist, partnership and talent forms validate input but do not submit or save personal data until the owner connects a backend. No registration has been recorded from a static-form interaction.
